column1: # The ways iText's tests open the encrypted PDFs of itext-dotnet, one line for each
# way of opening one file, read from the test classes named above each group.
# fetch-corpus.ps1 writes these lines to _passwords.tsv with the suite's name in
# front of each file, and fetches the certificates and keys they name.
# A password line gives a password the test class holds that PDFBox opens the
# file with, as the user or the owner; every such password is given, and an
# empty one besides where the file also opens with none. The exceptions are the
# files of revision 7, which PDFBox refuses before it looks at a password: their
# lines give the passwords the tests use. A certificate line gives, relative to
# the suite, the certificate and private key the test decrypts with, and the
# passphrase of the key, empty for a key that is not encrypted.
